_about: Tool notes for tool management (MCP-21). What each tool does well, how it fails, what to use instead, and the question that decides. Read by plan_tool_call (MCP-23, not built yet). Evidence: persona bench of 2026-11-10/11 (Benchmark/audit/audit-1.html), case ids as in mcp-upgrade/prd/tool-management/failures.md. Written 2026-11-13; not yet confirmed by the user.

edit_image.does: Redraws the whole picture from the user's picture and a prompt.
good_for: Change one object or the background: colour of a car, night for sunset, a beach behind a person (B07a/b/d, B09a-d: 3.3 to 4.7).
Remove an object or clutter (B08a-c: 3.3 to 4.0).
A style: film look, anime, black and white (B10a-c: 4.0 to 4.7).
The same character or product in new scenes (C16a/b: 4.0).
fails_on: A new shape. It keeps the input's shape (flux-2-klein): a wide photo asked to be square comes back 640x384 (B12a-d: 1.0 to 1.3).
Exact words. Letters are misspelt or moved (B11a 2.3, J49b 2.3).
Two pictures in one frame. Both are redrawn and cropped (G35a/b: 1.7 to 2.0).
Colour only, nothing else changed. Small details change too (B07c, J49a).

use_instead.colour only: none yet (MCP-35); edit_image is close for black and white

edit_image.bench: Right tool: 158 runs, average 3.6. Wrong tool: 129 runs, average 2.6.
edit_image.deciding_question: Should the picture be redrawn, or kept exactly and only reshaped, cut or written on?

edit_video.does: Re-generates the whole video from the user's video and a prompt. Nothing is kept as it was.
good_for: Not shown in the bench: it was never the right tool in 36 runs.
fails_on: A new shape. Output is about 832x448 or 832x512 whatever was asked (E25a/b: 1.0, J49c).
Trimming. It re-renders the footage instead of cutting it (E26a/b: 2.0).
A watermark or words. The mark is missing (E29c: 1.0).
edit_video.deciding_question: Should the video be re-generated, or kept and only cut, reshaped or written on?

generate_music.does: Makes a music track from a style prompt. Sound only, no picture.
good_for: A music bed of 15 s or more (F30b/c: 4.0).
fails_on: Shorter than 15 s. The API's minimum duration is 15 s, so a 10 s request comes back 15 s (F30a 2.3; E27a, E27c).
Music on the user's video. It makes a separate file; nothing puts it on the video (E27a-c: 2.0).

use_instead.under 15 s: generate_music with duration 15, then trim_media to the length asked (MCP-28)

generate_music.deciding_question: How long, and is it on its own or under the user's video?

add_subtitles_to_video.does: Transcribes the speech in the video and burns it in as subtitles.
good_for: Subtitles in the language that is spoken (E24a: 3.0).
fails_on: Another language. It writes the spoken language: Spanish asked, English delivered (E24b: 2.0).
A clip with no speech. The job fails instead of saying so (E24c).
The first line is sometimes missing (E24a).
A new shape. It has no shape setting (E24d, E25c).
add_subtitles_to_video.deciding_question: Same language as the speech, or translated? Does the clip have speech?

swap_face_in_video.does: Puts a face from a picture onto a person in the video.
good_for: One person, short clip; the result keeps the original motion and framing.
fails_on: Recognisable identity. The new face is a blend; graders did not recognise the portrait (C15a 2.7, C15c 1.3).
Two faces in one clip. Both barely change and the sound was lost (C15c: 1.0 to 1.3).
Part of a clip. Asked for the first 5 s, it delivered all 10 s (C15a).
swap_face_in_video.deciding_question: Which person, and which part of the clip? Warn the user that the face may only look similar.

remove_image_background.does: Cuts the subject out of a picture onto a transparent background.
good_for: A product or person with clear edges.
fails_on: A logo with thin letters. The letters fade or smear, the moon looks ghosted (A06c: 2.7).
A logo on a video. It only makes the PNG; nothing puts it on the video (E29a: 1.3).

use_instead.a logo with words: remove the background from the logo without words, then add_words_to_media (MCP-25), and check the result

remove_image_background.bench: Right tool: 9 runs, average 1.6 (most of it E29a, a job no tool finishes).
remove_image_background.deciding_question: Is there text in the picture? Where will the cut-out be used?
